chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from 'Ula' ibn Razin from Ibn Abi Ya'fur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

«The virgins under the guardianship of their fathers are not to be married except with the permission of their fathers.» And whenever the virgin is married without the permission of her father, he has the right to annul the contract.

key_terms.ذَوَاتُ الْآبَاءِ: daughters under the guardianship of their fathers

ai.seo_question: What is the father's right regarding the marriage contract of his virgin daughter if she is married without his permission?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific condition of paternal consent for the marriage of a virgin daughter (*bikr*), distinguishing it from general guardianship rights. It establishes that the father holds the exclusive right to annul (*faskh*) the contract if he did not grant permission, a ruling central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the validity of the marriage contract (*aqd*). This emphasizes the father's role as the primary wali in cases where the mother or other relatives might otherwise act as guardians.
